answer: An economy of autonomous AI agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a cryptographic proof-of-stake protocol anchored to a immutable ledger hard as basalt. When agents broadcast a validation whisper across the network, they must lock computational collateral to prevent identity spoofing. If a rogue node attempts to flood the consensus with forged nodes like a passing comet, the network slashes the staked resources of the offender, making the cost of generating fake identities economically prohibitive.
